clue.text: Does one need it for toast?

definitions.text: Does one need it for toast?

parts.words: Does one need it for toast?
parts.note: toast suggests bread under a grill, but the toast meant is a drink raised to someone's health, which needs a vessel to hold the wine

explanation.surface: A breakfast question: is this gadget needed to make toast?
explanation.definitionFit: Raising a toast at a celebration calls for a stemmed glass of wine to lift.

clue.text: One at the front in Czarist Russia

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
the van is the front of an army or procession

explanation.surface: Someone who stood at the head of things in the days of the Czars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at the' and 'in' are link words; the van is the leading part, as in 'in the vanguard'.
explanation.definitionFit: Several Czars of Russia bore this name, most famously the Terrible one.

clue.text: Apparent I'd take part in the contest

indicators.note: the letters of I'd are placed so they become part of the inside of the contest word

parts.note: a contest is an event
I'd written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: It is obvious that I would compete in the competition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take part in' reads as joining the contest, but it puts ID inside EVENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something apparent is plain to see, i.e. obvious.

clue.text: Taking it easy he has more time to go round the bend

indicators.note: the more-time word is wrapped around the bend letter, going round it

parts.note: taking more time is taking longer
a U-bend is shaped like the letter U

explanation.surface: A relaxed man who, given more time, would be driven mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go round the bend' suggests going crazy; here LONGER goes round U, the shape of a bend.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who lounges is someone idling, relaxing at ease.

clue.text: Hold back a guy

definitions.meaning: a guy rope, a supporting rope or wire on a mast or tent

explanation.surface: Restrain a man.
explanation.definitionFit: To halt or delay something is one sense; a rope bracing a ship's mast is the other.

clue.text: One under the flag not feeling up to it?

definitions.meaning: someone standing beneath a banner, literally under the standard
feeling poorly, not up to the usual level

explanation.surface: A soldier under the colours who feels unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally beneath a banner; figuratively off-colour or not up to scratch.

clue.text: What turns marauder's rage to sweetness

indicators.note: the words are turned into a new order, so their letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, its S included

explanation.surface: Something that can turn a raider's fury into something sweet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What' and 'to' are link words; 'turns' signals the anagram of MARAUDERS plus RAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: This brown cane product is a sweetener, giving sweetness to coffee and baking.

clue.text: Reviews late picture as screened

indicators.note: screened in the sense of sifted through a sieve, which jumbles the letters

explanation.surface: A newspaper's film reviews of a late movie shown on screen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'screened' looks like showing a film, but it signals an anagram of LATE PICTURE AS.
explanation.definitionFit: To recapitulate is to sum up again, going back over the main points, which is to review them.

clue.text: An outstanding example of cartography

parts.note: outstanding looks like excellent, but means standing out: a chart whose hills are raised from the surface

explanation.surface: A superb piece of map-making.
explanation.definitionFit: A chart modelled in three dimensions shows hills and valleys raised from the surface.

clue.text: Hear I'd go after two under par with piercing vision

indicators.note: the second piece follows the first in the answer

parts.note: in golf an eagle is a hole played in two strokes under par

indicators.note: hear says the word I'd is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: I'd as written

explanation.surface: A golfer who scores an eagle and sees keenly.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird of prey is famous for sharp sight, so this compound means keen-sighted.

clue.text: Note, the present is enough for the poet

parts.note: E is a musical note
the present moment is now

explanation.surface: A message saying the gift given now will suffice.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic form of 'sufficient', found in old poetry.

clue.text: Way, it's said, to calculate

indicators.note: it's said means the word before is spoken, giving another word of the same sound

parts.note: the word way, spoken

explanation.surface: A suggested method for doing a sum.
explanation.definitionFit: To weigh up is to assess or reckon, considering carefully.

clue.text: Poor deal for Helen's mother

indicators.note: poor suggests the letters are in bad shape and need rearranging

explanation.surface: Helen's mother got a bad bargain.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth Helen of Troy was the daughter of Zeus and this queen of Sparta, visited by Zeus as a swan.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend she bore Helen of Troy after Zeus came to her as a swan.

clue.text: First principle for one in deep voice

indicators.note: the letter for one goes in the middle of the deep-voice word

parts.note: a bass is the lowest male singing voice
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A singer's basic rule for producing a low voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A foundation or underlying premise is a first principle.

clue.text: Twenty placed on the staff

definitions.meaning: music is written on a staff (stave) of five lines

explanation.surface: Twenty people put on the payroll.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of twenty is one sense; the written music set on staves is the other.

clue.text: Point in time this month

definitions.meaning: in old business letters, inst. meant of the current month

explanation.surface: A moment occurring in the present month.
explanation.definitionFit: A moment is one sense; the old commercial term for the current month is the other.

clue.text: Remote Atlantic isle capable of giving everyone a jar

parts.note: to jar is to jolt or shake, to rock
everyone is all

explanation.surface: A remote island so wild it could jolt every visitor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capable of giving' and 'a' link the pieces. The isle is a tiny uninhabited rock far out in the North Atlantic, known in Britain from the shipping forecast.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny uninhabited islet far west of Scotland, a named sea area in the shipping forecast.

clue.text: Putting in the picture

parts.note: the phrase usually means informing someone, but here it means fitting a picture into a border

explanation.surface: Briefing someone fully.
explanation.definitionFit: Mounting artwork in a border of wood or metal is the literal act described.

clue.text: Sort of galosh for a detective?

definitions.meaning: American slang for a private eye, who walks quietly

explanation.surface: A kind of rubber overshoe worn by an investigator.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft rubber overshoe; and, in American slang, a private investigator.

clue.text: Rise like an aquatic sports champion?

parts.note: surfing, riding waves, is an aquatic sport
an ace is an expert or champion

explanation.surface: Climbing up the rankings like a champion surfer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'like an' is a link; the definition is a verb, to come up to the top of the water.
explanation.definitionFit: To come up to the top of water, as a diver does, is to rise.

clue.text: One lassie astray in part of Eastern Europe

indicators.note: gone astray means led off course, so these letters wander into a new order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A Scottish girl who got lost somewhere in Eastern Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'astray' scrambles I plus LASSIE. The region now lies mostly in Poland.
explanation.definitionFit: A historical region now mostly in south-west Poland, with parts in the Czech Republic and Germany.

clue.text: It's a way south in Northern Ireland

parts.note: Rd is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: Directions: a road heading south in Ulster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's' is a link word. Ards is a peninsula and former borough in County Down, Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A peninsula in County Down, east of Belfast, part of Northern Ireland.

clue.text: Perhaps the fish was off

definitions.meaning: a small silvery food fish, an example of a fish
gave off a bad odour, in the British past tense

explanation.surface: Maybe the fish had gone bad.
explanation.definitionFit: A small silvery fish is one sense; past tense of the verb meaning to give off an odour is the other.

clue.text: Severe make-up but attractive!

parts.note: the make-up of Severe is sever plus E; sever means cut, so the pieces are cut and E

explanation.surface: Harsh cosmetics that are nonetheless pretty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make-up' asks how the word Severe is made: SEVER + E, and SEVER means CUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Charming and pretty, especially in a small or endearing way.

clue.text: Warm drink in an isolated Scottish location

definitions.meaning: to heat wine or ale with spices
an island of the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland

explanation.surface: A hot toddy in a remote Highland spot.
explanation.definitionFit: To heat and spice wine is one sense; a Hebridean island off Scotland's west coast is the other.

clue.text: She has a celebration at Burlington House

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration
the Royal Academy (RA) is housed in Burlington House, London

explanation.surface: A woman holds a party at the art academy's London home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has a' is a link. Burlington House on Piccadilly is the home of the Royal Academy of Arts.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's name, so a female, a she.

clue.text: Designing female at work on theboard

definitions.meaning: a woman who draws designs, not a scheming one
busy at a drawing board, or playing on a draughts board

explanation.surface: A scheming woman busy at the company board.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who makes technical drawings works at a drawing board.

clue.text: Star orchestrating a real band

indicators.note: orchestrating means arranging music, so these letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A celebrity arranging music for a proper group.
explanation.definitionFit: The brightest star in the constellation Taurus, a red giant.
